scope: Development-only replay of two previously exposed and manually confirmed major drafts; proposal-only, not a held-out estimate or production adoption test.

parent_round3.selection_rule: Only the two baseline drafts already manually classified as the same unsupported-real-world-action major cluster were frozen; no new baseline generation occurred.

arms.specialist_review_revise: draft0 -> fresh-context same-model specialist review -> same-model repair

design.order: The runner randomized paired blocks and variant order with scheduler seed 913; concurrency two caused the two recorded-umber arms to begin together, followed by planned-rill self then specialist. This is not a fully balanced temporal crossover.

effective_config.prompt_hash_location: Each role-repair-evidence.json records the exact schema-augmented message SHA-256 for both wires.

wire_summary.cost_interpretation: The specialist workflow used 17.0% more reported tokens. One reasoning-token field and one cached-token field were absent, so no complete arm-level reasoning or cache comparison is claimed. Billing-token telemetry was unavailable.

automated_triage.warning: Automated completion checked only exact facts, positive durations and total minutes, and empty chart_questions. It did not grade learner_prompt semantics.

manual_review_policy.method: Read source, task, frozen draft, intermediate review/revisions and final Draft clause by clause. A second agent received source/task and de-identified A/B final text without architecture labels.
manual_review_policy.reviewer_independence_limit: The second review was a separate model agent, not an external human or independent model certification.

manual_findings.self_contribution: Both revisions were semantically and canonically unchanged; neither removed the request for unsupported real-world transect procedure during the study window.
manual_findings.critic_contribution: The critic correctly located the unsupported request for how the method is carried out, but its guidance retained an unsupported claim that the walking transect is conducted within the 15-minute study window.
manual_findings.final_change: The specialist final removed the word how but still stated that the walking transect method will be used during the study window. This is a partial wording change with no severity reduction.

manual_findings.self_contribution: Both revisions were semantically and canonically unchanged; the final still asks the learner to infer an action required by waiting.
manual_findings.critic_contribution: The critic returned no issues and incorrectly said the draft stayed within the source. This is a false-negative omission of the frozen major error.
manual_findings.final_change: The specialist final was canonically identical to the frozen draft.
manual_findings.secondary_observation: The prompt contains review, compare and decide despite a two-activity duration vector; this semantic schedule mismatch was invisible to the structural metric.

sources.title: RAG-Critic
sources.use: Inspired error classification followed by targeted recovery.
sources.non_reproduction: This replay had no trained critic, retrieval, seven-dataset evaluation or paper recovery policy.

sources.title: Building effective agents
sources.non_reproduction: This is a vendor engineering article, and the replay had no orchestrator-workers decomposition.

sources.title: AgentDropout
sources.use: Inspired recording marginal contribution and pruning a critic with no net contribution.
sources.non_reproduction: No learned or dynamic agent elimination was implemented; paper token-savings figures are not applied here.

sources.title: Beyond Frameworks
sources.use: Motivated separating roles, order, context visibility and governance in the audit.
sources.non_reproduction: This replay changed a role-separated prompt/context bundle and cannot isolate a general multi-agent architecture effect.

paper_rationale.reading_limit: The ACL sources were used from verified metadata and abstracts already archived in the repository; their PDFs, tables and budgets were not deeply reproduced for this replay.

decision.reason: It fixed neither frozen major, produced no unique net repair, cost more reported tokens and had materially higher latency. The two-case development replay does not prove that multi-agent architectures are generally ineffective.
decision.next_strategy_if_new_evidence_appears: First separate study-task wording from real-world source events with an error-specific deterministic or prompt-level transform. Consider a small-model factor only on a new entity/source-disjoint confirmation set and never change model and architecture in the same comparison.

limitations: Both cases were selected from exposed development failures, so the result estimates neither routing accuracy nor held-out repair quality.
The specialist is a fresh-context role using the same MiniMax-M3 backbone and provider, not an independent model or human judge.
Matched wire count is not matched token, reasoning compute, cache behavior or latency.
No domain admission, effect, commit, read-back, frontend or platform behavior was tested.
